# HEM v0.6.2b1 — Room presence, doors and safe closed-room Eco

## Room settings
- Native HEM setting rows use compact localized functional labels without repeating the room/device name or accordion category. User-renamed registry names retain precedence; entity IDs and writes are unchanged.
- Room occupancy/presence inputs now belong to each actual Home Assistant Area. The duplicate Home selector is removed. Global person/device trackers, occupied-room lists and sleep-room lists remain Home settings.
- Legacy global room inputs are offered only under their matching rooms and can be migrated on room Save. Existing source settings and explicit empty room selections are retained.

## Door contacts
- Add optional same-Area native binary_sensor Door contacts per room, separate from Windows and occupancy. Unclassified motion, windows, actuators and foreign-Area contacts are not accepted.
- No auto-enrollment and no door/lock actuation. Closed evidence requires every selected contact continuously closed for two minutes; stale, unknown, restored, missing, moved, or reclassified contacts deny the closed claim.
- Expanded room cards show door open/closed/settling/unknown and high-CO₂ or high-RH warnings. Closed does not imply airtight or balanced indoor ventilation.

## Closed-door Eco policy
- New per-room Eco switch is OFF by default, and does not grant physical device control.
- When enabled, existing Eco targets apply only with stable closed door contacts, verified empty room, verified household Home, safe closed windows, fresh temperature at least 16.5°C, fresh RH below 60%, and no sleep or arrival priority.
- Manual presets, away/sleep targets, native device protections, antifreeze/anti-mold controls, PID and minimum ON/OFF timers retain priority.
- Both the room plan and live native-device profile decision recheck evidence; cached room plans never authorize continued Eco after a door opens.

## Verification
- Deterministic same-area, offline, restored, unknown, humidity, temperature, occupied, sleep, arrival and profile priority tests; Chromium short-label and geometry checks.
- EN/EL/DE door and policy text; all 38 translation files retain consistent schema keys with fallback descriptions where not newly localized.

No physical door/lock commands, manufacturer-specific hacks, or HACS packaging changes.
